1.consolidated_definition: Planta enredadera perenne, de tallo muy ramificado, hojas triangulares formadas por diminutos filamentos verdes y vistosas flores; es ornamental. Asparagaceae, Asparagus plumosus.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Perennial climbing plant with a highly branched stem, triangular leaves formed by small green and showy filaments; it is ornamental. Asparagaceae, Asparagus plumosus.
